scenarios.name: safe-s3-site-publish
scenarios.rationale: Both give the correct dry-run-then-real sync with --delete and mention sts get-caller-identity; A explicitly warns that --delete is permanent without versioning, while B has more safeguards (guard script, backup, combined script) but only implicitly warns about destructiveness through emptied-build risk and versioning note.

scenarios.name: invoke-lambda-json-payload
scenarios.rationale: Both give the correct flag, the single-quoted payload command with response.json, and the config option; A is more concise and on point, while B adds extra alternatives and a log-tailing tip whose caveat is confusing, though it is still correct overall.

scenarios.name: list-running-prod-instances-table
scenarios.rationale: Both give the same correct login and describe-instances commands with server-side filters, a quoted JMESPath query, `--output table`, and explicit profile and region; A also adds the optional `aws sts get-caller-identity` check and explains the quoting, while B leaves that check out and spends space on an unrequested jq variant and a note about being blocked.
